## Research Plan: Multimodal RAG Papers

- [x] Query arXiv API for recent multimodal RAG papers
- [x] Fetch paper details (titles, abstracts, dates)

```python
# Let me parse all 15 papers' details more carefully
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

tree = ET.parse('arxiv_response.xml')
root = tree.getroot()

ns = {
    'atom': 'http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom',
    'arxiv': 'http://arxiv.org/schemas/atom'
}

entries = root.findall('atom:entry', ns)

all_papers = []
for entry in entries:
    title = ' '.join(entry.find('atom:title', ns).text.split())
    summary = ' '.join(entry.find('atom:summary', ns).text.split())
    published = entry.find('atom:published', ns).text
    paper_id = entry.find('atom:id', ns).text.split('/abs/')[-1]
    
    all_papers.append({
        'arxiv_id': paper_id,
        'title': title,
        'abstract': summary,
        'published': published
    })

# Print all papers with full details for selection
for i, p in enumerate(all_papers):
    print(f"\n{'='*80}")
    print(f"PAPER {i+1}: {p['arxiv_id']}")
    print(f"Title: {p['title']}")
    print(f"Published: {p['published']}")
    print(f"Abstract: {p['abstract'][:800]}")
    print(f"{'='*80}")
```
